title: Agent CLI Contract
summary: Test CLI output, exits, errors, and repeat runs before agents depend on them.
user: CLI maintainers whose commands are driven by coding agents and scripts.
smallest_useful_product: Run a declarative fixture suite against another CLI, snapshot text and JSON output, validate exits and error taxonomy, detect nondeterministic fields, and write Markdown and JSON reports.
constraints: Run every fixture in an isolated temporary directory.
Execute only commands declared by the maintainer.
